performance.scope: One Arena allocation, serial E104/candidate/E104 processes, three input seeds each; no independent repeat or official score claim.

npu_accuracy: v7 unchanged 3-seed/15-comparison package PASS, including all 11520 FFN output values. Separate zero-input raw-scale diagnostic retains a documented subnormal flush difference.
closure_reason: The implementation errors were repaired and v7 passed the unchanged standard NPU correctness screen. Its measured FFN median is 18.58% above the adjacent E104 control midpoint; close this implementation without performance tuning under the measured-regression rule.
retry_condition: A later C13 cost redesign must reduce integer weight-conversion/quantization work or otherwise change the cost mechanism. Current data rejects this measured combination, not all integer architectures.
untried_shortlist: C12 remains unimplemented, but its current scope is local Main/Sub resource placement; do not present it as a new whole-FFN architecture.
policy_change: AGENTS.md now distinguishes repairable source/layout errors from demonstrated SDK limitations and measured losses; compile count alone is not a reason to abandon a concrete supported repair.

diagnosis.v3: F32 transpose supports two rows, not four; corrected to paired 8B scale records.
diagnosis.v4_v5: Fetch-sequencer normalization discarded anonymous high padding for the 60-slice H quantizer; explicit anonymous factor did not fix it.
diagnosis.v6: Four named identical input copies retain a full 256-slice partition and compile. Full Arena execution returns non-finite FFN outputs; no performance aggregate from that run.
diagnosis.v6c_v6d: K=3840 plain integer dot has 0/960 mismatches; inline narrow/per-block scale after I32 unzip/zip has 956/960 mismatches. Weight conversion and normal H/L quantization match independently.
diagnosis.v7: Keep exact integer sums in F32 DM, then apply restoration in a fresh tag-zero FP stream. Diagnostic scaled dot returns 0/960 mismatches and full standard FFN accuracy passes.
diagnosis.root_cause_limit: The problematic compiled operation composition is isolated. The precise internal compiler/ISA cause is not established.
diagnosis.zero_scale_boundary: For all-zero inputs, hardware returns restoration scale 0 instead of the CPU mathematical subnormal 2^-134; digits are zero. All four diagnostic jobs retain 1200 raw-scale bit mismatches and are not labeled globally passing.

c14_review: c14-assessment.md: prior padded producer/consumer DMA failure does not prove C14 is impossible; a per-stage compaction repair is identified but not executed in this work.
